notes.title: 🍰 Summer, sweets, and a little sin… Welcome to Paris!
notes.content:
Step into the shoes of a small-town apprentice with big pastry dreams. This summer, Paris is your playground. Whip up desserts in an iconic patisserie, impress picky customers, and unlock romantic encounters with charming locals.

But beware — living in your wealthy cousin’s mansion comes with unexpected… perks. Flirty adventures, steamy choices, and hilarious mishaps await!

KEY FEATURES🥐 Pure Parisian Summer Vibes — Explore the sunny streets, cozy cafés, and secret corners of a romanticized, modern-day Paris.🥐 Dessert-Making Mini-Games — Mix, bake, decorate — and impress! Your skills in the kitchen lead to more than just praise… they unlock deeper (and hotter) storylines.🥐 Branching Romance Paths — Meet unique girls with distinct personalities and backgrounds. Choose who to bond with — or chase them all.🥐 Life at the Mansion — Living with your wealthy cousin? Expect surprises. Clean the house, do chores, or get into a little “trouble” after hours.🥐 Play Your Way — Focus on love, desserts, or both. Your choices unlock different scenes, routes, and endings. Discover every flavor of this naughty Parisian tale.
